2608.08575.title: CDGC-Net: 3D Medical Image Segmentation with Cooperative Dual-Scale Self-Attention and Grouped Channel Modeling
2608.08575.paper_summary: Accurate 3D medical image segmentation requires the integration of long-range anatomical context with fine boundary detail. Existing methods often model global and local features in separate modules or feature levels and perform channel recalibration independently. This may cause semantic mismatch between global context and local boundaries, insufficient channel relationship modeling, weak spatial-channel interaction, and redundant representations. We propose CDGC-Net, a 3D medical image segmentation network that combines cooperative dual-scale spatial attention with grouped hierarchical channel modeling. With-in each CDGC block, Cooperative Dual-Scale Self-Attention (CDSA) assigns attention heads to parallel local-window and global-sparse branches. The two branches capture fine spatial details and long-range anatomical context at the same feature level. Their outputs are concatenated into an $N\times C$ spatial representation and directly passed to Grouped Hierarchical Channel Attention (GHCA). GHCA organizes the channels into $r$ groups and models both within-group and cross-group dependencies. CDSA and GHCA reuse a shared key projection to maintain a consistent feature reference. Residual feature alignment subsequently integrates the refined features with the original representation. On the Synapse, ACDC, BraTS, and LA datasets, CDGC-Net achieved mean DSC values of 86.96\%, 92.91\%, 82.56\%, and 93.52\%, respectively, exceeding the next-highest reported values by 0.39, 0.47, 0.17, and 0.32 percentage points. CDGC-Net contains 25.83M parameters and 28.62G FLOPs for an input size of $64\times128\times128$, reducing these quantities by 39.87\% and 40.30\%, respectively, relative to UNETR++. These results indicate a favorable trade-off between segmentation accuracy and computational complexity.
2608.08575.paper_summary_zh: 準確的3D醫學影像分割需要將長距離的解剖上下文與精細的邊界細節相結合。現有的方法通常在不同的模組或特徵層次中建模全局和局部特徵，並獨立執行通道重校準。這可能導致全局上下文與局部邊界之間的語義不匹配、通道關係建模不足、空間-通道互動弱以及冗餘的表示。我們提出了CDGC-Net，一種結合協作雙尺度空間注意力與分組層次通道建模的3D醫學影像分割網絡。在每個CDGC區塊中，協作雙尺度自注意力（CDSA）將注意力頭分配給平行的局部窗口和全局稀疏分支。這兩個分支在相同的特徵層次上捕捉精細的空間細節和長距離的解剖上下文。它們的輸出被串接成一個$N\times C$的空間表示，並直接傳遞給分組層次通道注意力（GHCA）。GHCA將通道組織成$r$組，並建模組內和組間的依賴關係。CDSA和GHCA重用共享的鍵投影來保持一致的特徵參考。殘差特徵對齊隨後將精煉的特徵與原始表示整合。在Synapse、ACDC、BraTS和LA數據集上，CDGC-Net的平均DSC值分別達到86.96\%、92.91\%、82.56\%和93.52\%，超過下一個最高報告值0.39、0.47、0.17和0.32個百分點。CDGC-Net包含25.83M參數和28.62G FLOPs，對於輸入大小為$64\times128\times128$，相對於UNETR++，這些數量分別減少了39.87\%和40.30\%。這些結果表明在分割準確性和計算複雜性之間存在良好的權衡。
